decisions.reason: The multi-model LHD loader line is the core of the firm's announced underground mining direction and has absorbed heavy investment, so after dropping the dump trucks management will defend it and attribute weak results to temporary market and pandemic causes.

The single construction site dumper uses the firm's existing vehicle know-how at modest extra cost, and its results can still be blamed on pandemic-era disruption, so management keeps it despite lower strategic centrality.
The inclined furniture lift line was given its own web page and several models, a visible commitment within the lifting segment that management feels obliged to justify.
The building material lift line has its own page, several models, and close ties to the firm's construction and lifting focus, so sunk investment and public commitment favour persistence.
The truck-mounted furniture lift is a single variant that builds on the lift platform investment and was publicly showcased, so management keeps it and treats weak demand as temporary.
